ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The schematic diagram marks Dongting Lake and its surrounding areas. In the enlarged map on the right, place names such as “Dongting Lake,” “Chenglingji,” “Yichang,” and “Changsha” can be seen. Dongting Lake is connected with the Yangtze River channel to the north. Surrounding rivers flow into the lake and are connected with the Yangtze River water system, belonging to an external-flow river-lake system. Information such as hydropower stations and minerals in the legend has little relation to the judgment of the water cycle type in this question. Reasoning: The question stem asks “besides the internal cycle,” that is, among the types of water cycle, to judge what other type the Dongting Lake basin participates in besides the terrestrial internal cycle. Since in the figure the Dongting Lake basin is connected with the Yangtze River, basin water can ultimately flow into the ocean via the Yangtze River, forming water exchange between land and ocean, so it also participates in the sea-land intercycle.

raw_record.question_text:
Read the schematic diagram of a certain region of our country:

<image1>

Besides the internal cycle, what other type of water cycle does the Dongting Lake basin participate in?

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中标出洞庭湖、城陵矶、宜昌及与长江相连的河湖水系，显示洞庭湖流域属于外流河湖系统。再读题干“除内循环外”是在三类水循环中询问另一种类型。根据外流流域的水经河流汇入长江并最终入海这一桥梁，判定它除陆地内循环外还参与海陆间循环。
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：示意图中标出了洞庭湖及其周边地区，右侧放大图能看到“洞庭湖”“城陵矶”“宜昌”“长沙”等地名，洞庭湖与北侧的长江河道相连，周边河流汇入湖泊并与长江水系连通，属于外流河湖系统。图例中的水电站、矿产等信息与本题水循环类型判断关系不大。
推理：题干问“除内循环外”，即在水循环类型中判断洞庭湖流域除陆地内循环外还参与哪一种。由于图中洞庭湖流域与长江相连，流域水可经长江最终流入海洋，形成陆地与海洋之间的水分交换，因此它还参与海陆间循环。
